name: Prime Formal Tide-Surge Dataset v1
source: Primary tide-gauge data with FES2022 tide removal
quality_status: YES ny_bight us_gulf_coast south_atlantic_charleston southeast_australia thames_north_sea
column15: water_level_m (= observed - tide = surge residual per FORECAST_TASK_CONTRACT.md). Verified: water_level_m + tide_level_m = total_water MAE < 1e-6m across all 5 regions. NOAA data (US regions) public domain

name: NOAA CO-OPS 3 Verified Gauge Stations
source: NOAA Center for Operational Oceanographic Products and Services
column15: 8761724 (TX Galveston). 10 years x 12 months = 360 monthly CSVs
column18: 160 data rows. API enforces 31-day hard limit → implemented month-chunking. Used for prime-formal validation.

name: International Best Track Archive for Climate Stewardship v04r01
source: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information
column15: 164 track points. NA basin 2015-2024: 216 unique storms (145 tropical_cyclone
column17: 15 extratropical_or_subtropical). SHA256: verified. Primary source for G1 canonical storm grouping.

name: Atlantic Hurricane Database HURDAT2 + Eastern Pacific
column14: 2004 tropical cyclones loaded from Atlantic + Eastern Pacific. Cross-validates IBTrACS NA basin counts. STATUS field (HU/TS/ET/TD) enables proper storm typing in repaired storm_events.py. SHA256: verified.

name: ERA5 Hourly Single Levels Reanalysis
column13: Needs CDS API token at ~/.cdsapirc. Provides U10/V10 wind
column17: wind gusts. CRITICAL: ERA5 is REANALYSIS not forecast archive. Can augment with wind stress
column19: inverse-barometer for P6 physics-guided models. 5 regional subsets estimated ~5 GB. Requires user action: register at cds.climate.copernicus.eu

name: GEBCO Gridded Bathymetry 2026
source: GEBCO (General Bathymetric Chart of the Oceans)
quality_status: Can download regional subsets from download.gebco.net without registration or CDS auth. Or via CEDA OPeNDAP. Provides bathymetry for coastal slope
column13: physical storm surge constraints. Estimated size 5 regional subsets ~2 GB each.

name: Global Extreme Sea Level Analysis v3
license: CC BY 4.0 co-authorship if used substantially
quality_status: Potential expansion dataset. 2000+ gauges worldwide covering gaps in prime-formal dataset (Australia
column14: South America). Requires registration form at gesla.org (no API key needed). Can augment with surge residual data from non-US gauges. Low priority vs ERA5/GEBCO.

name: Permanent Service for Mean Sea Level
resolution: Monthly means + hourly tide gauge links
quality_status: Monthly means useful for long-term background sea level but not directly for storm surge forecasting. Hourly tide gauge links exist but not yet enumerated.

name: NOAA CO-OPS Non-Prime Gauges
quality_status: 115 candidate gauges outside prime-formal regions. Need quality filter: 10+ years + known datum + 2015-2024 coverage. Queue behind P5 G8 pilot retrain and P4 ERA5 download.

name: University of Hawaii Sea Level Center
quality_status: Pacific + Indian Ocean gauges filling gaps in prime-formal global coverage. Requires FTP download after registration.

name: GEM Australia Tide Gauge Network
quality_status: 35 Australian gauges. Can augment southeast_australia region coverage. Public data portal accessible.

name: GLORYS Global Ocean Physics Reanalysis
quality_status: Sea surface height + ocean currents + temperature + salinity. Requires CMEMS/Motu API key. Supplementary for physics-guided models.

name: GTSM Global Tide and Surge Model forced by ERA5
quality_status: Global tide and surge model provides simulated total water level at coastal points. Requires ERA5/CMEMS access for forcing. Supplementary comparison dataset.
